title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime with the help of Lieutenant Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent. Their alliance is tested when a psychopathic criminal mastermind known as the Joker unleashes catastrophic anarchy upon Gotham City.

title: Avengers: Endgame
description: In the grim aftermath of Thanos wiping out half of all life across the universe, the surviving Avengers assemble one final time. Risking everything through quantum realm mechanics, they mount an audacious bid to undo the cosmic decimation.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
description: In a post-apocalyptic desert wasteland where gasoline and water are scarce commodities, Imperator Furiosa rebels against a tyrannical ruler to liberate five captive women. Joined by lone drifter Max Rockatansky, they engage in a relentless, high-octane road pursuit.

title: Jurassic Park
description: Industrialist John Hammond invites a select group of scientists and his grandchildren to preview an ultra-secret remote island wildlife park populated with cloned dinosaurs. When security systems fail during a storm, the guests must fight for survival against ferocious prehistoric predators.

title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
description: Blacksmith Will Turner teams up with eccentric scoundrel pirate Captain Jack Sparrow to rescue his abducted love from Jack's mutinous former crew. Unbeknownst to them, the cursed crew transforms into immortal living skeletons under the moonlight.

title: Mission: Impossible – Fallout
description: When a clandestine assignment to recover stolen plutonium cores goes wrong, Ethan Hunt and his IMF team are forced into a desperate race against the clock. Monitored by a relentless CIA operative, they must foil a global catastrophic plot before nuclear detonations occur.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
description: After more than thirty years of distinguished service as a navy test pilot, Pete 'Maverick' Mitchell is called back to train an elite detachment of Top Gun graduates for a perilous specialized mission. Confronting the ghosts of his past, he must prepare the young pilots for the ultimate sacrifice.

title: Gladiator
description: Victorious Roman general Maximus Decimus Meridius is betrayed when corrupt prince Commodus murders his emperor father and seizes the throne. Reduced to slavery and trained as a gladiator, Maximus battles through the arena to avenge the murder of his family and save Rome.

title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
description: With Peter Parker's secret superhero identity exposed to the worldwide public, he seeks assistance from Doctor Strange to cast an oblivion spell. A miscalculation shatters the boundaries of space-time, unleashing multiverse adversaries and forcing Peter to redefine what it means to be Spider-Man.

title: The Batman
description: In his second year fighting crime, Bruce Wayne ventures deep into the shadows of Gotham City to track a sadistic serial killer known as the Riddler. As clues unmask systemic municipal corruption, Batman is forced to forge uneasy alliances and question his family's legacy.

title: Inception
description: Dom Cobb is a skilled corporate thief who specializes in the extraction of subconscious secrets through dream-sharing technology. Offered a shot at redemption and a return to his children, he must achieve the impossible inverse task: inception, planting an idea inside a target's mind.

title: Interstellar
description: As global crop blights and dust storms render planet Earth progressively uninhabitable, former pilot Joseph Cooper joins a secret space exploration crew. Traveling through a mysterious wormhole near Saturn, they search for an interstellar sanctuary to ensure human survival.

title: The Matrix
description: Quiet computer programmer Thomas Anderson discovers through enigmatic rebel Morpheus that his mundane reality is actually a sophisticated simulated neuro-illusion maintained by sentient machines. Embracing his destiny as Neo, he wages war against synthetic agents for humanity's freedom.

title: Dune: Part Two
description: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen desert dwellers on Arrakis while seeking vengeance against the conspirators who devastated his aristocratic house. Caught between love and a terrifying prescient vision of galaxy-wide holy warfare, he must decide whether to claim the throne.

title: Arrival
description: When twelve extraterrestrial spacecraft hover silently above diverse global locations, linguistics professor Louise Banks is recruited by military forces to decipher the alien communication glyphs. As geopolitical tensions boil toward warfare, her evolving comprehension of their language reshapes her perception of time.

title: Blade Runner 2049
description: Thirty years after the events of the original detective narrative, LAPD replicant blade runner Officer K unearths a long-buried secret capable of plunging civil society into apocalyptic chaos. His search for answers drives him on a quest to locate Rick Deckard, an ex-enforcer vanished for decades.

title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
description: An orphaned eleven-year-old boy learns on his birthday that he is the orphaned son of two renowned sorcerers and possesses magical abilities. Invited to attend Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, Harry uncovers his fabled history and the dark wizard responsible for his parents' demise.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
description: Shy hobbit Frodo Baggins inherits the primordial One Ring from his uncle Bilbo, learning that the dark lord Sauron will conquer Middle-earth if it returns to his grasp. Accompanied by eight loyal companions across kingdoms and mountains, Frodo embarks on a peril-filled pilgrimage to Mount Doom.

title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
description: Exhausted laundromat owner Evelyn Wang is overwhelmed by an impending tax audit and fractured family ties when an alternate-dimension husband unlocks her multiverse consciousness. To defeat an omnipotent nihilistic entity, she must channel the divergent skills of her alternate life paths.

title: Avatar
description: Paraplegic marine Jake Sully is dispatched to the lush alien moon of Pandora on an espionage mission to infiltrate the indigenous Na'vi community using a biologically engineered hybrid avatar. As his empathy and love for Neytiri grow, he is torn between corporate mining orders and defending Pandora.

title: Se7en
description: Retiring detective William Somerset and impetuous newcomer David Mills partner to investigate a string of gruesome homicides linked to the seven deadly sins. As each murder scene grows increasingly methodical and horrific, the detectives find themselves drawn into the killer's macabre philosophical game.

title: Shutter Island
description: U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels travels with his new partner to Ashecliffe Hospital for the criminally insane on a desolate Boston Harbor island to investigate an escaped patient's disappearance. Cut off by a hurricane, Teddy's hallucinations, personal traumas, and hospital deceptions erode his grip on reality.

title: Gone Girl
description: On the morning of their fifth wedding anniversary, former journalist Nick Dunne reports that his glamorous wife Amy has disappeared without a trace. Under intense police scrutiny and escalating media circus, Nick's evasive behavior leads the public to question whether he killed her.

title: Knives Out
description: When wealthy patriarch and mystery novelist Harlan Thrombey is found dead with his throat slit at his Gothic estate, debonair private detective Benoit Blanc is mysteriously hired to investigate. Blanc must navigate a minefield of self-serving family members and red herrings to expose the truth.

title: The Silence of the Lambs
description: FBI trainee Clarice Starling is tasked with interviewing imprisoned cannibalistic psychiatrist Dr. Hannibal Lecter to gain psychological insights into a prowling serial murderer named Buffalo Bill. In exchange for clues, Lecter extracts intimate confessions regarding Starling's childhood traumas.

title: Get Out
description: Young African-American photographer Chris Washington accompanies his white girlfriend Rose Armitage for a weekend getaway to meet her affluent parents at their secluded upstate estate. What begins as uncomfortable racial pleasantries soon spirals into a horrifying conspiracy of physical and psychological subjugation.

title: The Conjuring
description: Paranormal researchers Ed and Lorraine Warren are summoned to a Rhode Island farmhouse where a family is terrorized by malevolent nocturnal phenomena. Upon uncovering a sinister satanic curse dating back to colonial witch trials, the Warrens must confront pure supernatural malevolence.

title: A Quiet Place
description: In an eerie devastated landscape overrun by blind predatory beasts with hyper-sensitive acoustic tracking, a close-knit family lives in absolute silence. When the impending birth of a newborn threatens their soundproof routines, survival demands radical ingenuity and maternal courage.

title: Parasite
description: The impoverished Kim family schemes to infiltrate the lives of the wealthy Park family by securing domestic employment under fabricated professional identities. When an unexpected discovery in the subterranean cellar surfaces, the symbiotic parasitism explodes into an uncontrollable clash of socioeconomic desperation.

title: Train to Busan
description: A self-absorbed fund manager and his estranged daughter board a high-speed commuter train from Seoul just as a virulent viral outbreak transforms citizens into ferocious zombies. As the contagion breaches carriages during the 453-kilometer journey, passengers must band together to survive until Busan.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
description: Wrongfully convicted of murdering his wife and her lover, quiet banker Andy Dufresne is sentenced to consecutive life terms at Shawshank State Penitentiary. Over two decades, Andy earns the warden's reliance while secretly forging an unbreakable bond with fellow lifer Red and engineering the ultimate escape.

title: Forrest Gump
description: Kindhearted Alabama man Forrest Gump, possessing an unassuming intellect, witnesses and inadvertently influences several defining cultural milestones of twentieth-century America. Through all his accidental triumphs, Forrest never forgets his childhood companion and eternal love, Jenny Curran.

title: The Pursuit of Happyness
description: Struggling salesman Chris Gardner loses his life savings, his apartment, and his spouse, finding himself homeless on the streets of San Francisco with his young son. Refusing to yield to adversity, he perseveres through an unpaid competitive stockbroker internship to rebuild his life.

title: Whiplash
description: Ambitious young jazz drummer Andrew Neiman enrolls at an elite Manhattan conservatory with aspirations of achieving greatness. When selected for the top studio orchestra led by ruthless conductor Terence Fletcher, Andrew is pushed to the physical and emotional brink of madness in pursuit of perfection.

title: The Green Mile
description: During the Great Depression, death row corrections officer Paul Edgecomb oversees condemned inmates along 'The Green Mile'. When a gentle giant named John Coffey arrives convicted of a monstrous crime, Paul discovers the prisoner possesses an extraordinary and divine supernatural gift of healing.

title: Titanic
description: Seventeen-year-old aristocrat Rose DeWitt Bukater falls passionately in love with penniless bohemian artist Jack Dawson aboard the ill-fated maiden voyage of the RMS Titanic. When the 'unsinkable' luxury liner strikes an iceberg in the North Atlantic, their love turns into a desperate struggle for life.

title: La La Land
description: Aspiring actress Mia and passionate jazz pianist Sebastian pursue their artistic aspirations in contemporary Los Angeles while navigating an electric romance. As professional breakthroughs begin to manifest, the compromises necessary for their careers threaten to pull their romance apart.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
description: In the fictional European republic of Zubrowka between the world wars, legendary concierge Monsieur Gustave H. presides over a glorious mountaintop hotel. Framed for murder over a priceless Renaissance painting, Gustave and his loyal lobby boy Zero embark on a whimsical, whirlwind adventure.

title: Coco
description: Young Miguel dreams of becoming an accomplished musician despite his ancestral family's ancestral ban on melody. Desperate to prove his talent on the Day of the Dead, Miguel accidentally crosses into the radiant Land of the Dead, unlocking the hidden truth of his lineage with charming trickster Héctor.

title: Inside Out
description: Inside the mind of eleven-year-old girl Riley, five personified emotions—Joy, Sadness, Fear, Anger, and Disgust—guide her choices through life changes. When a cross-country family move causes emotional turmoil, Joy and Sadness are cast into the outer reaches of long-term memory.

title: 3 Idiots
description: Two longtime friends embark on an interstate search for their vanished university comrade Rancho, whose radical unconventional philosophies transformed their perspectives on higher education. Moving between past and present, they reminisce about defying academic rat-races and discovering true passion.

title: Dangal
description: Former national wrestling champion Mahavir Singh Phogat confronts deep-rooted social conservatism in rural Haryana to coach his two young daughters, Geeta and Babita. Defying mockery and prejudice, the sisters rise through intense discipline to conquer international Commonwealth Games glory.

title: Lagaan
description: During the Victorian British Raj in 1893, drought-stricken villagers in Champaner are subjected to tyrannical agricultural taxation. Led by spirited peasant Bhuvan, the villagers accept an arrogant British captain's wager: a game of cricket, with three years of tax cancellation if they prevail.

title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
description: Three childhood friends—Kabir, Imran, and Arjun—reunite for an extended road trip across Spain as a bachelor celebration before Kabir's wedding. As each takes turns choosing an extreme sport adventure, they confront personal phobias, corporate burnout, and unresolved resentments.

title: Andhadhun
description: Akash, an ambitious piano player feigning visual impairment to sharpen his musical focus, inadvertently witnesses the murder of an aging film star inside a private apartment. Caught between silence and survival, Akash is plunged into a chaotic downward spiral of deception, extortion, and bodily peril.

title: Queen
description: Devastated when her fiance abruptly calls off their traditional wedding one day before the ceremony, modest New Delhi girl Rani decides to embark on their booked European honeymoon entirely alone. Journeying across Paris and Amsterdam, she discovers independent strength, uninhibited joy, and self-worth.

title: Gully Boy
description: Murad, a college youth raised in the crowded Dharavi tenements of Mumbai, channels his domestic frustrations and societal disenfranchisement into potent street poetry. Mentored by underground rap icon MC Sher, Murad defies socioeconomic barriers to give voice to the streets.

title: Taare Zameen Par
description: Eight-year-old Ishaan Awasthi struggles with academic comprehension and reading letters, leading his exasperated parents to send him away to a strict boarding academy. An empathetic art instructor, Ram Shankar Nikumbh, diagnoses Ishaan's dyslexia and patient mentoring reignites the child's artistic brilliance.

title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
description: Pawan Kumar Chaturvedi, a devoted and upright devotee of Lord Hanuman, discovers a mute six-year-old Pakistani girl stranded alone in Delhi. Determined to reunite her with her loving family without a passport or visa, Pawan embarks on a dangerous and heartwarming cross-border pilgrimage.

title: Drishyam
description: Modest cable television provider Vijay Salgaonkar orchestrates an ironclad alibi using techniques learned from cinema after his family is implicated in an extortionist's accidental death. Facing brutal interrogations by a ruthless Inspector General seeking her missing son, Vijay protects his household.

title: RRR
description: In 1920s colonial Delhi, fearless tribal protector Komaram Bheem and dedicated British police officer Alluri Sitarama Raju forge an electrifying friendship without revealing their covert identities. When betrayal and duty collide, their brotherhood ignites a full-scale armed revolution against imperial tyranny.

title: Baahubali 2: The Conclusion
description: The tragic history of Mahishmati kingdom is illuminated as noble prince Amarendra Baahubali falls in love with princess Devasena, triggering the jealousy of conniving Bhallaladeva. Decades later, his rightful heir Mahendra rallies loyal forces to avenge his parents and reclaim the golden throne.

title: Pushpa: The Rise
description: Pushpa Raj, an audacious daily laborer in the Seshachalam hills of Andhra Pradesh, rises rapidly through the cutthroat ranks of the illegal red sandalwood smuggling syndicate. Refusing to bend before syndicates or law enforcement, his defiance precipitates an intense standoff with a sadistic police superintendent.

title: KGF Chapter 2
description: Having seized control of the blood-soaked Kolar Gold Fields, Rocky establishes unchallenged supremacy as the messianic champion of enslaved miners. His reign faces lethal challenges when ruthless barbarian warlord Adheera emerges from the shadows and the central government mobilizes the army.

title: Kantara
description: In coastal Karnataka, hot-headed rebel Shiva defends his tribal village's sacred forest heritage against bureaucratic forest officers and a duplicitous feudal landlord. When ancestral spirits demand justice, sacred Bhoota Kola rituals unleash an incandescent, mythological reckoning.

title: Eega
description: A kindhearted young man named Nani is murdered by an arrogant industrialist who lusts after his beloved Bindu. Reincarnated as a common housefly with intact human memories, Nani mounts an ingenious, comedic, and deadly campaign of vengeance against his killer.

title: Sita Ramam
description: Lieutenant Ram, an orphaned Indian army officer stationed in 1960s Kashmir, receives anonymous letters from an enigmatic woman named Sita Mahalakshmi declaring her profound devotion. Twenty years later, a rebellious London student is tasked with delivering Ram's final undelivered letter to Sita.

title: Mahanati
description: Chronicles the meteoric rise and tragic personal unraveling of Savitri, South Indian cinema's first female superstar. Investigated by two young journalists after the legendary actress falls into a coma, her life story reveals generosity, groundbreaking talent, and heartbreaking betrayals.

title: Vikram
description: A covert black-ops agent investigates a string of masked vigilante assassinations targeting top narcotics cartel enforcers in Chennai. As the investigation deepens, the elusive mastermind's identity is revealed, sparking an all-out warfare between ghost operatives and a vicious drug empire.

Two high school sweethearts from the graduating class of 1996, travel photographer Ram and married homemaker Jaanu, reunite after twenty-two years at a school batch reunion. Over the course of a nostalgic night in Chennai, they confront unspoken desires and lingering heartbreaks.

title: Drishyam
description: Orphaned self-made businessman Georgekutty constructs an intricate, movie-inspired matrix of fabricated alibis to safeguard his wife and teenage daughters after an accidental killing. His family's solidarity is tested under brutal psychological interrogation by an authoritarian police force.

title: Manjummel Boys
description: Based on a real incident from 2006, a boisterous group of young men from Kochi vacation at Kodaikanal's perilous Guna Caves. When their friend Subhash plunges into a subterranean crevice known as the 'Devil's Kitchen', the boys stage a courageous, unprecedented rescue defying all odds.

title: Premam
description: Follows the romantic evolution of George David through three defining chapters of his life: an infatuation during teenage school days, a bittersweet romance with his college lecturer Malar, and an unexpected mature connection during adulthood.

title: Bangalore Days
description: Three inseparable cousins—Divya, Kuttan, and Aju—fulfill their childhood ambition of relocating together to the cosmopolitan city of Bangalore. While experiencing youthful independence and career ambitions, their lives are challenged by marital rifts, motocross dreams, and unexpected romances.

title: Kumbalangi Nights
description: Four dysfunctional brothers share a dilapidated homestead in the backwater hamlet of Kumbalangi, characterized by mutual hostility and domestic neglect. When the younger brother falls in love with a neighbor, the brothers must unite to confront her hyper-masculine, controlling brother-in-law Shammi.

title: Ustad Hotel
description: Faizi dreams of becoming a master European chef against the wishes of his conservative father, who cuts him off financially. Relocating to Kozhikode to work alongside his philosopher grandfather at modest beachfront restaurant 'Ustad Hotel', Faizi discovers the true soul of hospitality and community service.

title: Charlie
description: Fleeing an arranged marriage, free-spirited Tessa rents a bohemian room in Kochi previously inhabited by an eccentric, nomadic vagabond named Charlie. Enchanted by his unfinished comic sketches and tales of good deeds, Tessa embarks on a whimsical quest across Kerala to find him.

title: Kirik Party
description: Traces the college trajectory of mischievous engineering student Karna and his ragtag gang of campus pranksters. A devastating tragedy during their sophomore year shatters his playful innocence, forcing Karna to mature into a reflective, hardened senior leader.

title: Lucia
description: An insomniac cinema usher named Nikki obtains a mysterious underground pill called 'Lucia' that promises him the ability to live his dream life as a revered film superstar while asleep. As waking reality and lucid nocturnal fantasies intertwine, the boundaries between desire and nightmare collapse.

title: Dia
description: Introverted biotechnology student Dia secretly pines for senior Rohith for three years before an abrupt tragedy disrupts their blossoming confession. Just as she learns to smile again through the buoyant friendship of Adi, fate presents an emotionally devastating revelation.
